title: Baseline Green Rate
summary: The unconditional share of sessions that closed above their open: the baseline every conditional preset in this catalog should be compared against. The denominator is every complete session for the symbol; the numerator is the green ones. A conditional rate only means something relative to this number and its interval: 60% green after some pattern is not a finding if the market printed 58% green everywhere. The attached open-to-close return distribution is the size counterpart of the same baseline.
deltas: the anchor number for every other preset, computed on identical data with identical guards
per-year counts show drift in the baseline itself
